description: University Grants Commission - The Open University of Sri Lanka (Amendment) Ordinance, No. 1 of 2020
categorisation: This gazette content contains an ordinance made by the University Grants Commission amending the Open University of Sri Lanka Ordinance. It involves legal/regulatory matters - specifically amendments to existing legislation, departmental structures, and study programs. This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and modifications to the legal framework governing universities, rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or any of the other specialized categories.
